methods.description: Full candidate-pointset bounding-box screening and native-coordinate topological relation checks against every feature of complete retained ADM2 and ADM3 GeoJSON products. Preserve every bbox candidate. This is a source-coverage screen, not a metric geometry measurement: no area/distance values, geometry repairs, CRS transforms, or authority inference.
methods.software: Python 3.12.14; Shapely 2.1.2; GEOS version recorded at run
methods.units: coordinate values in source GeoJSON; no physical area/distance unit claimed
methods.crs: Source metadata does not pin a CRS declaration in these retained GeoJSON products. Coordinates are interpreted as x/y pairs exactly as stored; geographic WGS84 convention is a stated assumption and remains a limitation.
methods.area_method: No area measurement; exact topology predicates in native coordinate plane only.

methods.description: Count unique families in the complete source-fitness slice; retrieve each family best-rank tuple from the complete immutable family shards; sort by the pinned ORDER_NAMES in ascending lexicographic order and locate the selected family.
methods.software: Python 3.12.14; gzip; standard-library JSON and SHA-256

methods.units: features or source rows; source-name multiset differences and shapeID set differences

conclusions.text: The advertised ADM2/ADM3 counts match the pinned sourceData archive record counts (736/6,836), while retained simplified products contain 735/6,822 features. Source-name differences are recorded; the processing cause remains unidentified.

Within the retained administrative source geometries and exact stored coordinate pairs, every declared component intersects at least one feature in both India products. This is source-relative administrative coverage only.
Physical dry-land versus inland-water status, observation date, legal authority and processing cause remain unresolved for every component; no independent dated physical-surface evidence is included.
